description: The Consortium of Municipalities of the Province of Bolzano publishes complementary public-lighting network layers through the South Tyrol catalogue. Illumination-Pipes describes main and feeder networks; Illumination-Nodes describes lamps, electrical cabinets and network nodes. Coverage is South Tyrol; both use the same municipal-infrastructure GeoServer workspace, carry a 26 November 2021 issue date and list WMS and WFS access. They are grouped as one infrastructure inventory; two older metadata entries identify the same named layers. Access is free under CC0 1.0. These network elements can support lighting-network flow and capacity-planning inputs. The issue date does not establish the asset observation period. Municipal completeness, electrical connectivity, coordinates, equipment ratings and operating condition remain unverified because no features were requested. Related South Tyrol electricity-grid and district-heating records describe other networks. The service descriptors establish layer identities, but they do not prove a ready-to-run electrical model.
